responsibility: Implements storage creation for per-node clone_info summaries attached to the symbol table. Its main job is to lazily allocate and initialize the function_summary used to record virtual-clone replacement maps and parameter-adjustment metadata for cgraph nodes. This file is a minimal support companion to symtab-clones.h and the heavier clone-manipulation logic elsewhere.
same_name_distinction: Contains the tiny implementation backing symtab-clones.h: chiefly lazy creation of the symbol-table function_summary used to attach clone_info records to cgraph nodes, not the clone_info layout itself.
